nodes.label: RATIO: Retrieval Across Typed Ideation Operations
nodes.author: Maayan Sharon, Tom Hope
nodes.rationale: Benchmark for scientific inspiration retrieval using three ideation operations (ADDRESS, BROADEN, SPECIFY) constructed via discourse-marker distant supervision from full-text scientific papers.

nodes.label: RATIO Ideation Moves: ADDRESS, BROADEN, SPECIFY
nodes.rationale: Three operation-specific retrieval tasks for scientific inspiration: ADDRESS retrieves approaches/insights responding to problems; BROADEN retrieves broader/more general formulations; SPECIFY retrieves concrete instances/narrower formulations. Represent complementary moves through ideation space.

nodes.label: Discourse-Marker Distant Supervision for Retrieval
nodes.rationale: Extends discourse-marker supervision from sentence-pair classification to corpus-scale retrieval. Phrases like 'to address this problem', 'more generally', 'as an example' identify adjacent sentences presenting problem-addressing, broader, or more specific relations. Markers stripped from input, used to define relevance.

nodes.label: RATIO Marker Lexicon Construction Pipeline
nodes.rationale: Multi-stage process: manual curation (400 frequent markers, expert inspection of 15 samples each), LLM expansion (SOTA models label candidates as strong-true/weak-true/false), rule-based pattern expansion (Hearst-style templates), expert screening. Yields 4,252 validated markers (3,862 ADDRESS, 316 BROADEN, 74 SPECIFY).

nodes.label: RATIO Temporal Split for Contamination Prevention
nodes.rationale: Train: 2015-Sept 2025; Validation: Oct-Dec 2025; Test: Jan-May 2026. Ensures no test query/candidate seen during training; test pairs from papers published after all evaluated models' pre-training. Conservative evaluation of generalization to unseen text.

nodes.label: RATIO Silver Test Set with Human-Calibrated LLM Validation
nodes.rationale: High-precision evaluation set created via LLM filtering with human calibration. Two LLM judges evaluate query/gold for grammar, coherence, self-containment, and relation enforcement. Prompts calibrated against 300 expert annotations (F1 .83-.87). Final set: 17,579 queries with gold candidates.

nodes.label: A Relation-Marker Vocabulary: Full Construction
nodes.rationale: Constructs a comprehensive lexicon of discourse markers for three semantic relations (ADDRESS, BROADEN, SPECIFY) through iterative LLM generation, pattern expansion, and embedding discovery, validated by NLP experts.

nodes.label: Marker Lexicon Generation
nodes.rationale: Three LLM models (Claude Opus 4.6, Gemini 3 Flash, GPT5.4) iteratively generate discourse marker variants tagged as strong-true, weak-true, or false to avoid single-model phrasing bias.

nodes.label: Pattern Expansion via Hearst Templates
nodes.rationale: Applies Hearst-inspired lexico-syntactic patterns with typed slots filled from curated term lists, expanded via NLTK, spaCy, and PyInflect morphological variants, then filtered by GPT-5.4.

nodes.label: Embedding Discovery
nodes.rationale: ALL-MPNET-BASE-V2 retrieves ten neighbors for each of 82 foundational markers from 9.5M sentence-initial comma-terminated phrases; GPT-4 validates ~30 additional markers.

nodes.label: Distractor Discourse Markers
nodes.rationale: 1,000 markers validated as distractors by NLP expert; remainder by LLM. Includes overly general markers (e.g., 'therefore') and markers signaling contrast/similarity relations outside target set.

nodes.label: Text Normalization and Cleaning
nodes.rationale: Regex-based heuristics applied: lowercasing, noise removal, introduction-clause removal, gold-sentence prefix cleaning, short-sentence removal (<35 chars).

nodes.label: Temporal Split Strategy
nodes.rationale: Balances three constraints: earlier training cutoff avoids model pretraining windows; 2025 validation allocation prevents inflation; single-year test partition prevents BROADEN starvation.

nodes.label: ALL-MPNET-BASE-V2
nodes.rationale: Sentence embedding model used for embedding discovery and retrieval baseline.

nodes.label: ModernBERT-Embed-Large
nodes.rationale: Modern embedding model evaluated with generic and recommended prefixes; achieves best MRR@10 on SPECIFY (39.1), ADDRESS (21.5), BROADEN (22.2).

nodes.label: Stella-EN-1.5B-V5
nodes.rationale: Instruction-tuned embedding model; achieves highest MRR@10 on SPECIFY (41.1) and BROADEN (20.1) with recommended prefix.

nodes.label: Multiple Negatives Ranking Loss
nodes.rationale: Contrastive learning loss with in-batch negatives; scale s=20 (τ=0.05) used for all models.

nodes.label: BM25 Lexical Baseline
nodes.rationale: Unigram, bigram, trigram variants with English stopword removal and Snowball stemming; implemented via BM25S and Faiss index.

nodes.label: GPT-5.4 Automatic Judge
nodes.rationale: LLM-as-judge via OpenAI Batch API; full judging prompt in system message, instance in user message, JSON response format, reasoning_effort=medium.

nodes.label: Silver Test Set Construction
nodes.rationale: 400 silver queries per relation sampled via confidence filtering; top 100 candidates retrieved, top 10 judged by human annotators; hard/soft agreement metrics.

nodes.label: Relevance Judge Calibration
nodes.rationale: 100 pairs per relation manually annotated by NLP expert; 4-6 prompts tested per relation; two highest-F1 prompts retained.
